title: State mammal.
bodyText: The Hawaiian monk seal (Monachus schauinslandi) is established and designated as the official mammal of the State.
crossReferences: Taking a monk seal prohibited, see §195D-4.5.

[§5-12.5]  State mammal.  The Hawaiian monk seal (Monachus schauinslandi) is established and designated as the official mammal of the State. [L 2008, c 72, §2]

 

Cross References

 

  Taking a monk seal prohibited, see §195D-4.5.
